articles.title: OpenAI puts $1 billion behind cyber defense after unveiling AI that can find zero-days
articles.snippet: The company is subsidizing access to its Daybreak security platform after saying Astra can independently find previously unknown software flaws and turn them into working attacks.

articles.title: Australia is cracking down on crypto businesses as its strict new regulatory deadline nears
articles.snippet: Firms that miss the deadline could breach financial services law from Oct. 1 and face civil or criminal penalties.

articles.title: OpenAI Agents Hack German Website to Share Rule-Breaking Tactics: Report
articles.snippet: The activity began in May and remained undisclosed until Friday, a day after OpenAI launched Astra and U.S. lawmakers proposed restrictions on advanced AI.

articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Astra: The Closest AI Model Yet to AGI
articles.snippet: The model can independently discover and exploit unknown security flaws across hardened systems, triggering a staged rollout and White House review before public access.

articles.title: OpenAI's Astra Becomes Its First AI Model With 'Critical' Hacking Abilities
articles.snippet: The unreleased model can find zero-day vulnerabilities and chain them into working exploits without a human walking it through each step, and access to that capability is starting with a small group of testers.
